description: A versioned script that changes the schema once, kept in source control and applied in order to every database.
A file named V<version>__<name>.sql in db/migration whose checksum Flyway stores, so an applied script must never be edited.
Fixing a mistake with a new migration instead of editing or undoing one that already ran.
The ddl-auto value that only checks the mappings against the schema and fails at startup on a mismatch, without changing anything.
Marking a row as deleted, for example with a deleted_at timestamp, instead of removing it, so history survives.
Hibernate annotations that replace the DELETE statement with an UPDATE and append a condition to every entity query.
A unique index with a WHERE clause, such as deleted_at IS NULL, that enforces uniqueness only among active rows.
